description: JASDF free-loan airframe with 302 Sqn markings; wing pylons fitted but no stores; installed 29 Jun 2011

JASDF free-loan airframe with 501 Sqn markings and a special intake-vane marking; one of the seven limited-conversion RF-4EJs; on conversion from fighter to reconnaissance the serial was changed from 87-8412 to 87-6412 because the JASDF digit 8 denotes a fighter and 6 a reconnaissance aircraft
